02 / UNDER THE HOOD

How the prediction works

Four steps you can explain in a viva.

01
ZnO

Enter a formula

The material is broken into its elements and their amounts.

02

Find atomic fractions

Each element becomes a share of the total atoms. For ZnO, Zn and O are each 50%.

03
♣♣♣

Ask 200 trees

Each decision tree follows the composition through learned splits to one estimate.

04
Σ ÷ 200

Average their answers

The forest averages all 200 tree outputs to predict the gap in eV.

CURRENT FORMULA

Atomic composition

The bars show the actual fractions passed into the model.

03 / PROJECT NOTES

A visual way to present the model.

This demo runs the saved random forest directly in your browser. It uses 118 element inputs and returns a numerical estimate for the band gap.

200decision trees
118element features
6,354experimental entries in the supplied CSV
PLEASE NOTE

A prediction is an estimate, not a laboratory measurement. The model sees elemental fractions, not crystal structure or molecular context, so unfamiliar compounds and isolated molecules need extra caution. An experimental CSV value is shown separately when the exact formula is present; those entries are not an independent accuracy test.
